anomalies.observed: R5 is a 1K resistor connecting the MCU PWM signal net to the unregulated VCC rail. The same PWM net contains U2 pin 6 and U3 pin 6, and those MCU VCC pins are powered from the +5V regulator output.
anomalies.expected: A pull-up or base-drive resistor on an MCU-driven signal should be referenced to the MCU supply (+5V), or otherwise clamped to the MCU voltage, not tied to the regulator input / fan supply rail VCC.
anomalies.impact: If VCC is the LM1117 input/fan supply, as implied by the regulator pinout, R5 can force the MCU PWM pins above their +5V supply, back-power U2/U3, and make the fan-control PWM path unreliable or damaging to the MCU.
